module_dispositions.rationale: Eqtb representation establishes assignment-state vocabulary.
Eqtb display establishes assignment-state vocabulary.
Glue registers and parameters occupy typed eqtb slots.
Symbolic printing definitions only.
Glue entries have canonical shared-zero initialization.
Diagnostic rendering only.
Local meanings and token parameters occupy typed eqtb slots.
Initialization and diagnostic definitions only.
Integer parameters and registers have canonical identities.
Names, initialization helpers, and diagnostics only.
Dimension parameters and registers have canonical identities.
Installation, initialization, display, and debugging definitions only.
Save-stack representation context.
Typed groups push boundaries and prior state.
Local definitions save once while globals bypass restoration.
Aftergroup tokens are retained on the save stack.
Unsave restores or retains meanings and replays aftergroup tokens.
Debug-memory pointer search only.
Magnification is checked and frozen at first preparation.
The chief executive dispatches expanded commands by mode.
Mode-table fallbacks complete top-level dispatch.
Errors, privilege checks, and stop handling are main-control policy.
Braces open groups or select finite mismatch recovery.
Typed right-brace handling restores scoped state.
Hyphenation exception scanning diagnoses invalid commands and lccodes while preserving word recovery.
Pattern scanning and application diagnose finalized tries, invalid commands and letters, and duplicate trie paths.
Prefixes expand, accumulate, validate, and resolve scope.
Definition targets recover non-control-sequence tokens with the inaccessible control sequence.
A set-font command assigns the current-font meaning with effective scope.
Def-family commands scan and install scoped macro token lists.
Let and futurelet install copied meanings with distinct lookahead delivery.
Character, math-character, and register shorthand definitions scan bounded operands.
Read-to defines one macro from the selected input stream with missing-keyword recovery.
Typed parameters, registers, code tables, and arithmetic scan and commit.
Setbox encodes effective scope in a deferred box-construction request.
Mode, page, and box auxiliary setters validate and mutate their distinct stores.
Parshape scans a bounded indentation/width vector and assigns it with eqtb scope.
Compile-time capacity assertion only.
Hyphenation exceptions and INITEX-only patterns have distinct global effects.
Font dimensions, hyphen characters, and skew characters mutate global font state.
Font definition scans size, loads or reuses a font, and binds its identifier.
Diagnostic spelling for selected fonts only.
Interaction primitives update process-global interaction and print selection.
Afterassignment stores and inserts one token after commit.
Assignment helpers retain the next substantive command.
Openin and closein replace read-stream state after bounded filename scanning.
Message commands expand text and select terminal or error behavior.
Errmessage selects user help or bounded built-in help and invokes error handling.
Case shift substitutes code-table characters in a scanned token list and replays it.
Show dispatch selects activities, box, meaning, or value inspection.
Show reports one raw token meaning with canonical names.
Showbox scans one register and displays void or box content.
Showthe renders one internal value through the_toks.
Show diagnostics terminate with canonical interaction-dependent completion.

Final cleanup retires input, reports open groups, coordinates conditional unwind, and selects end or dump cleanup. Conditional frame semantics and output termination remain cross-domain dependencies, not duplicate section claims.

properties.claim: Glue, meaning and token, integer, and dimension state occupy distinct canonical eqtb regions with typed defaults and selector identities.
preconditions: INITEX eqtb initialization has completed.
stimulus: Phase 2 unit `eqtb_regions_keep_parameter_register_kinds_and_shared_zero_glue_distinct` reads defaults and mutates each family.
expected_observations: Each selector reaches only its typed family and zero glue sharing does not alias muglue or scalars.
postconditions: Unchanged entries retain identity and changed entries retain typed values until restoration.
equivalence_cases: Named/numbered, ordinary/prefixed, local/global, nested, and source/replay selectors.
recovery_cases: Invalid selectors recover without mutating neighboring regions.

properties.claim: Opening a typed group pushes one boundary carrying prior group, boundary line, and level until matching unsave.
preconditions: An outer group is current and save-stack capacity remains.
stimulus: Phase 2 unit `nested_typed_groups_push_one_boundary_and_restore_outer_metadata` enters every group kind.
expected_observations: Each entry increments level once and records one typed boundary.
postconditions: Nested entry preserves outer metadata and aftergroup records.
equivalence_cases: Ordinary, explicit, box, math, alignment-shaped, and replay-created groups.
recovery_cases: Overflow reports before a partial boundary becomes current.

properties.claim: The first local mutation at a group level saves its prior value; repeated locals reuse that record, while effective globals survive exit and suppress stale restoration.
preconditions: A nested group and outer meaning/fullword values exist.
stimulus: Phase 2 white-box unit `save_stack_local_global_redefinition_restores_once_per_level` applies repeated local, explicit global, and globally superseded mutations.
expected_observations: Locals restore, globals survive, and deeper globals are never overwritten by stale saves.
postconditions: Ownership balances and the save stack returns to its boundary.
equivalence_cases: Meaning/register/parameter/code-table, ordinary/prefixed, nested, and replay assignments.
recovery_cases: Failed value scans create no save record or mutation.

properties.claim: Aftergroup tokens are saved in encounter order and, after restoration, backed up for FIFO replay before outer input.
preconditions: A group is active and distinguishable tokens can be scheduled.
stimulus: Phase 2 white-box unit `save_stack_aftergroup_tokens_replay_fifo_after_unsave` schedules tokens at two nested levels around restoration.
expected_observations: Inner tokens wait for inner restoration; each level replays FIFO.
postconditions: No aftergroup record remains on the retired level.
equivalence_cases: Ordinary, prefixed, local/global, nested, and source/replay groups.
recovery_cases: Mismatch recovery never replays tokens from a still-open level.

properties.claim: Closing a typed group restores saved locals unless globally superseded, restores outer metadata, and only then resumes token delivery.
preconditions: A non-bottom group has local and globally superseded saves.
stimulus: Phase 2 white-box unit `unsave_restores_local_entries_retains_globals_then_replays_tokens` closes nested groups and inspects state before delivery.
expected_observations: Locals restore, globals remain, outer group metadata becomes current, and lifetimes balance.
postconditions: The save pointer names the outer boundary with no reachable inner state.
equivalence_cases: Brace, explicit, box, math, and nested replay closures.
recovery_cases: Mismatched closers do not unsave the wrong group.

properties.claim: Magnification is range-checked when prepared, invalid values recover to 1000, and the first prepared value is frozen against later incompatible assignments.
preconditions: Magnification is not prepared.
stimulus: Phase 2 white-box unit `prepare_mag_bounds_and_freezes_first_effective_value` and minifixture `assignment-mag-freeze.tex` cover valid, invalid, repeated-equal, and repeated-different values.
expected_observations: Only 1..32768 is accepted initially; later differences diagnose and retain the frozen value.
postconditions: Prepared magnification is not undone as an ordinary scoped assignment.
equivalence_cases: Ordinary/global and nested/restored assignments before and after preparation.
recovery_cases: Invalid values diagnose and retain the canonical effective value.

properties.claim: Main control obtains one expanded command, dispatches on absolute mode plus command, and routes mode-independent meanings without consuming a second command.
preconditions: A resolved command and canonical mode are current.
stimulus: Phase 2 table unit `main_control_dispatch_matrix_consumes_each_command_once` and `main-control-modes.tex` cover every mode class.
expected_observations: One named arm owns each pair; illegal pairs reach specified recovery.
postconditions: The command is consumed once and input resumes at the next boundary.
equivalence_cases: Vertical/horizontal/restricted/math/display, source/replay, ordinary/prefixed assignment.
recovery_cases: Wrong-mode commands diagnose or insert canonical recovery without silent success.

properties.claim: Main-control errors identify command and mode, privileged operations reject internal modes, and stop with page material first forces page completion.
preconditions: A wrong-mode, nonprivileged, or stop command is current.
stimulus: Phase 2 unit `main_control_error_privilege_and_stop_paths_are_finite` and `main-control-recovery.tex`.
expected_observations: Rejected effects do not commit and stop terminates or drives the page builder first.
postconditions: Recovery leaves coherent mode/group/save state.
equivalence_cases: Outer/internal modes and source/replay after local/global histories.
recovery_cases: Repeated invalid input remains finite and stop cannot bypass pending material.

properties.claim: Left braces open simple groups; right braces dispatch by current group, while extra or mismatched closers use finite off-save recovery.
preconditions: A known mode and group are current.
stimulus: Phase 2 white-box unit `brace_dispatch_opens_normal_groups_and_recovers_each_mismatched_closer` drives normal and erroneous typed closures.
expected_observations: Correct braces change one level; mismatches insert the canonical closer and replay the offender.
postconditions: Mode, group, save pointer, and replay order agree after closure.
equivalence_cases: Simple/semi-simple/box/math/alignment-shaped and source/replay groups.
recovery_cases: Bottom-level, wrong-type, and excess closers diagnose once and progress.

properties.claim: Expandable calls are expanded and blank or relax commands are skipped between prefixes; legal bits accumulate idempotently, illegal prefixes diagnose and back_error replays the retained command, and globaldefs determines effective scope.
preconditions: Main control delivered a prefix.
stimulus: White-box and replay units cover repeated global/long/outer prefixes across spaces, relax, and macro calls, nested scope, afterassignment ordering, and exact illegal-prefix diagnostics and one-token replay.

The committed tex-exec prefixed-macro reference microfixture and canonical replay cover §404 filler plus an expanded call; the command-semantic prefix-collection minifixture covers the broader §1211 property.
expected_observations: One normalized prefix set reaches the command; rejection retains the substantive command.
postconditions: Prefix state clears and demand resumes exactly.
equivalence_cases: Repeated/expanded, local/global/globaldefs, nested, and replay cases.
recovery_cases: Illegal combinations report and execute or replay the retained command once.
The strict xfail pins the first canonical-versus-current execution mismatch and rejects XPASS or changed failure.

properties.claim: Target scanning skips spaces and substitutes the frozen inaccessible control sequence when the token is not redefinable.
preconditions: A definition command requires a control-sequence target.
stimulus: Phase 2 white-box unit `get_r_token_skips_spaces_and_recovers_non_control_sequence_targets` covers valid and invalid targets.
expected_observations: Valid targets remain; invalid tokens are backed up when required and inaccessible is inserted before restart.
postconditions: Scanning returns one redefinable control-sequence identity.
equivalence_cases: Direct/replayed targets with zero, one, or many spaces.
recovery_cases: Character and frozen targets diagnose and restart without defining them.

properties.claim: Selecting a font defines the current-font eqtb entry to the selected internal font at effective scope.
preconditions: A resolved set-font command is current.
stimulus: Phase 2 white-box unit `set_font_assignment_obeys_local_global_and_globaldefs_scope` selects distinct fonts across groups.
expected_observations: The entry changes to the command operand at the effective level.
postconditions: Local selection restores and effective global selection survives exit.
equivalence_cases: Ordinary/global/globaldefs and direct/replayed selection.
recovery_cases: Unresolved font meanings are rejected before assignment.

properties.claim: Def-family commands select expanded versus unexpanded token scanning and install call, long, and outer meanings at effective scope.
preconditions: Prefix and target scanning completed.
stimulus: Phase 2 white-box unit `def_family_selects_expansion_flags_meaning_kind_and_effective_scope` covers all four def commands.
expected_observations: Only expanded forms expand replacement text during definition and exact tokens remain installed.
postconditions: Local meanings restore and effective globals survive exit.
equivalence_cases: Def/gdef/edef/xdef with long/outer and direct/replayed replacements.
recovery_cases: Runaway or outer input follows scan_toks recovery without changing target identity.

properties.claim: Let copies one resolved meaning after optional equals/spaces, while futurelet copies lookahead meaning and restores both tokens in order.
preconditions: A redefinable target has been scanned.
stimulus: Phase 2 white-box unit `let_and_futurelet_copy_meaning_and_preserve_lookahead_order` covers reference ownership and replay.
expected_observations: The target receives the exact command/operand and futurelet leaves input order unchanged.
postconditions: Copied token-list meanings retain one reference and obey scope.
equivalence_cases: Let with/without equals; futurelet over character, primitive, and macro tokens.
recovery_cases: Invalid targets recover before source meaning is copied.

properties.claim: Character, math-character, and register shorthands temporarily relax their target, scan a bounded operand, and install canonical command/operand pairs.
preconditions: A shorthand command and target are current.
stimulus: Phase 2 white-box unit `shorthand_definitions_install_each_command_operand_and_bound_recovery` covers all seven kinds.
expected_observations: Each meaning identifies its command and character code or register eqtb location.
postconditions: The temporary relax meaning is replaced at effective scope.
equivalence_cases: All kinds with optional equals, self-reference, local/global/globaldefs, and replay.
recovery_cases: Out-of-range operands recover before final installation.

properties.claim: Read-to scans a stream number, recovers a missing `to`, scans a target, and installs the read token list as a parameterless macro at the effective prefixed-command scope.
preconditions: A read-to command is current and stream state exists.
stimulus: White-box units cover file, terminal, and closed streams plus local/global/globaldefs scope, exact meaning observation, afterassignment ordering, and replay.
expected_observations: After read_toks, the target receives one call meaning whose parameter text is empty and whose replacement is exactly the collected list; its mutation precedes afterassignment replay.
postconditions: Stream and scanner status reach canonical post-read state.
equivalence_cases: Present/missing `to`, direct/replayed targets, all stream classes, explicit local/global prefixes, and positive/negative globaldefs.
recovery_cases: Missing `to` diagnoses then continues; invalid targets recover through get_r_token.

properties.claim: Token, scalar, glue, muglue, code-table, and arithmetic assignments scan typed operands, normalize values, and commit at effective scope.
preconditions: A typed selector is current after prefix collection.
stimulus: Phase 2 white-box unit `typed_parameter_register_and_arithmetic_assignments_cover_scope_copy_and_bounds` exercises every family in nested scopes.
expected_observations: Types and ownership persist; zero glue normalizes; arithmetic failure makes no partial write.
postconditions: Locals restore, globals survive, and copied values remain independently owned.
equivalence_cases: Named/numbered, ordinary/prefixed, local/global, replay/restoration, direct/copied RHS.
recovery_cases: Bad braces/indices/ranges, overflow, and zero divisors retain prior values as specified.

cases: pinned first mismatch rejects XPASS and changed failure

properties.claim: Setbox scans a register and optional equals, encodes effective scope in the box-context flag, and starts box scanning only when allowed.
preconditions: A setbox command is current after prefix resolution.
stimulus: Phase 2 white-box unit `setbox_request_encodes_scope_and_rejects_disallowed_contexts` covers local/global and forbidden contexts.
expected_observations: Local indices remain 0..255 and effective globals become 256..511 before scan_box.
postconditions: Allowed commands yield one typed box request; forbidden commands yield none.
equivalence_cases: Local/global/globaldefs and direct/replayed setbox with optional equals.
recovery_cases: Forbidden alignment/accent contexts diagnose improper setbox without scanning a box.

cases: pinned first mismatch rejects XPASS and changed failure

properties.claim: Auxiliary setters validate mode or bounds and update space factor, previous depth/graf, page totals, counters, or box dimensions with their canonical global behavior.
preconditions: One auxiliary assignment and its owning mode/store are current.
stimulus: Phase 2 white-box unit `auxiliary_assignments_validate_mode_bounds_and_update_only_owned_state` covers every setter.
expected_observations: Only the selected auxiliary field changes and global prefixes do not alter commands that ignore them.
postconditions: Mode nest, page state, or box memory contains the scanned value exactly where specified.
equivalence_cases: Valid boundary values in outer/internal modes and direct/replayed commands.
recovery_cases: Wrong mode, bad space factor/prevgraf, and void box diagnose or no-op as specified.

properties.claim: Parshape scans a signed count, maps nonpositive counts to null, otherwise stores exactly that many indentation/width pairs at eqtb scope.
preconditions: A set-shape command is current.
stimulus: Phase 2 white-box unit `parshape_assignment_scans_pair_count_and_restores_local_shape` covers negative, zero, one, and multiple pairs.
expected_observations: Positive shapes preserve pair order and count; nonpositive input yields null.
postconditions: Local shapes restore and effective globals survive group exit.
equivalence_cases: Optional equals, local/global/globaldefs, nested restoration, and replay.
recovery_cases: Dimension scanner recovery supplies each malformed pair component before installation.

properties.claim: Hyphenation loads exception words in all profiles, while patterns load only under INITEX; scanner and application errors diagnose in canonical order while preserving TeX82 recovery and mutation.
preconditions: A hyphenation-data command and braced input are current.
stimulus: Phase 2 white-box unit `hyphenation_data_distinguishes_exceptions_initex_patterns_and_flush_recovery` covers both profile classes.
expected_observations: Exceptions update the exception table; INITEX patterns update tries; production patterns do neither.
postconditions: The entire braced argument is consumed and global hyphenation state has canonical lifetime.
equivalence_cases: Exceptions/patterns with empty, singleton, and multiple entries in INITEX and production profiles.
recovery_cases: Improper exception and pattern commands consume the offending command while retaining the partial word.
Zero lccodes are ignored in exceptions and retained as null pattern letters after diagnosis.
A duplicate pattern diagnoses and then replaces the prior operation.
Production pattern use reports the finalized-trie diagnostic and flushes through the matching right brace.

properties.claim: Fontdimen, hyphenchar, and skewchar assignments scan a font and value then update strictly global font information.
preconditions: A loaded font and font-parameter assignment are current.
stimulus: Phase 2 white-box unit `font_parameter_assignments_update_global_dimen_hyphenchar_and_skewchar` covers each selector.
expected_observations: Only the selected font field changes to the scanned dimension or integer.
postconditions: Group exit does not restore font information.
equivalence_cases: Direct font identifiers, current-font aliases, nested groups, and repeated assignment.
recovery_cases: Invalid fontdimen and font identifier scans diagnose before mutation.

cases: pinned first mismatch rejects XPASS and changed failure

properties.claim: Font definition scans a target, filename, and default/at/scaled size, reuses an equal loaded font or loads one, and records the newest identifier.
preconditions: A def-font command and font resource boundary are available.
stimulus: Phase 2 white-box unit `font_definition_scans_sizes_reuses_identity_and_recovers_illegal_values` covers default, at, scaled, reuse, and load.
expected_observations: Equal name/area/effective size reuses identity; otherwise one font loads and target/id text bind it.
postconditions: The target meaning obeys effective scope while loaded font data remains global.
equivalence_cases: Default/at/scaled equal sizes, case-distinct names, local/global targets, and retry after resource supply.
recovery_cases: Illegal scaled values become 1000 and improper at sizes become 10pt before load/reuse.

cases: pinned first mismatch rejects XPASS and changed failure

properties.claim: Interaction commands set the global interaction mode and recompute print selection according to terminal and open-log state.
preconditions: One interaction primitive is current.
stimulus: Phase 2 white-box unit `interaction_assignment_updates_mode_and_selector_for_log_state` covers all four modes with log open/closed.
expected_observations: Interaction equals the command operand and selector matches terminal/log policy.
postconditions: The mode survives groups and subsequent assignments.
equivalence_cases: All four modes, log open/closed, nested groups, and repeated commands.
recovery_cases: No value scanning occurs; an unresolved primitive is rejected before this action.

properties.claim: Afterassignment stores one unexpanded token, overwrites the slot on repetition, and inserts it after the next successful assignment before aftergroup or outer input.
preconditions: No assignment is mid-commit.
stimulus: White-box units cover pending aftergroup, failed assignments, and the complete ScannedStep assignment catalogue; committed microfixtures cover successful §325 replay and the no-token path.
expected_observations: Only the newest token fires once after effects and before aftergroup.
postconditions: The slot clears and the token retains inserted provenance.
equivalence_cases: Ordinary/prefixed, local/global/globaldefs, nested/replay/restoration, and assignment families.
recovery_cases: Failure or nonassignment does not fire or lose the token; retry fires once.

properties.claim: Assignment scanning skips spaces and relax commands and retains the first nonblank nonrelax expanded command exactly once.
preconditions: An assignment helper needs its next substantive command.
stimulus: Phase 2 unit `assignment_terminator_skips_space_and_relax_but_retains_first_command` uses source and replay.
expected_observations: Spaces/relax disappear, expansion occurs, and the substantive command remains current.
postconditions: Input resumes after canonical consumption.
equivalence_cases: Ordinary/prefixed, nested replay, and local/global continuations.
recovery_cases: EOF or malformed expansion recovers finitely without fabricating a terminator.

properties.claim: Closein closes an open read stream; openin first closes the prior stream, scans a filename with default .tex extension, and records closed or just-open state from the open result.
preconditions: A four-bit stream selector and host-neutral input capability are available.
stimulus: Phase 2 white-box unit `openin_closein_replace_stream_state_and_apply_filename_rules` covers open, replacement, explicit and default extensions, and close.
expected_observations: The selected stream alone transitions to closed or just-open with the scanned canonical filename.
postconditions: Any prior handle is closed before replacement and other streams remain unchanged.
equivalence_cases: Explicit/missing extension, optional equals, streams 0/15, and direct/replayed commands.
recovery_cases: Failed open leaves the stream closed after retiring its prior handle.

cases: pinned first mismatch rejects XPASS and changed failure

properties.claim: Message commands scan expanded balanced text, render it once, and route ordinary messages to terminal output with canonical line-spacing behavior.
preconditions: A message command and print selector state are current.
stimulus: Phase 2 white-box unit `message_expands_balanced_text_and_applies_terminal_line_spacing` covers short, wrapping, and nested expanded text.
expected_observations: Rendered text reflects expansion and ordinary message updates the terminal exactly once.
postconditions: The temporary token list/string is released and selector is restored.
equivalence_cases: Empty/nonempty, short/wrapping, nested macro, and source/replay message text.
recovery_cases: Runaway text follows scan_toks recovery before any partial message is emitted.

properties.claim: Errmessage prints expanded text, prefers errhelp when present, otherwise emits long built-in help at most once in non-error-stop interaction, then invokes error handling.
preconditions: Expanded errmessage text and interaction/errhelp state are available.
stimulus: Phase 2 white-box unit `errmessage_selects_user_or_once_only_builtin_help_and_clears_flag` covers all help branches.
expected_observations: User help wins; otherwise first and repeated built-in help differ exactly as canonical interaction requires.
postconditions: use_err_help is false after error returns and long_help_seen has canonical value.
equivalence_cases: Errhelp present/absent, first/repeated, scroll/error-stop interaction, and replay.
recovery_cases: Error continuation preserves input and does not retain temporary message storage.

properties.claim: Uppercase/lowercase scan an unexpanded token list, substitute nonzero code-table values in character and active-character tokens without changing command kind, then replay the list.
preconditions: Case-code tables and a balanced token-list argument exist.
stimulus: Phase 2 white-box unit `case_shift_preserves_raw_token_structure_at_code_table_boundaries` covers letters, other/active tokens, control sequences, and zero mappings.
expected_observations: Only eligible character codes with nonzero mappings change and replay order is preserved.
postconditions: The scanned list becomes replay input without a retained definition reference.
equivalence_cases: Upper/lower, letter/other/active, zero/nonzero mapping, nested groups, and stored replay.
recovery_cases: Runaway or missing brace follows scan_toks recovery before transformation.

properties.claim: Mode-independent show dispatch selects activities, box, raw meaning, or internal-value inspection from the show operand.
preconditions: One xray command is current in any mode.
stimulus: Phase 2 white-box unit `show_dispatch_selects_activities_box_meaning_or_value_without_mode_dependence` covers all four operands.
expected_observations: Exactly one inspection branch begins and operands are scanned only by that branch.
postconditions: Control reaches common diagnostic completion once.
equivalence_cases: All show commands in vertical, horizontal, and math modes from source and replay.
recovery_cases: Invalid command operands are impossible after primitive resolution and fail loudly if constructed.

properties.claim: Show consumes one raw token and prints its control-sequence spelling when present followed by tex.web §§294-298's exact command and token-list rendering; meaning conversion inserts the same rendering as character tokens.
preconditions: Show-meaning dispatch has begun.
stimulus: White-box tables cover character commands, registers, internal quantities, primitives, and every macro prefix combination; the semantic microfixture covers register aliases and a letter token.
expected_observations: The token is not expanded and its exact current command/operand determines the rendering.
postconditions: No assignment, expansion, or replay mutation occurs.
equivalence_cases: Control sequence/character and call/long/outer/long-outer/end-template meanings.
Register aliases render the underlying register command, never a Rust enum name.
recovery_cases: EOF raw-token recovery precedes meaning rendering.

properties.claim: Showbox scans an eight-bit register and displays either void or that box through diagnostic box rendering.
preconditions: Showbox dispatch and box registers are available.
stimulus: Phase 2 white-box unit `showbox_scans_register_and_distinguishes_void_from_box_contents` covers registers 0/255 and empty/nonempty values.
expected_observations: The heading names the scanned register and the body matches void or box content.
postconditions: The box register is not consumed or changed.
equivalence_cases: Void/nonvoid, boundary registers, nested groups, and replay.
recovery_cases: Out-of-range selectors recover through the eight-bit scanner before inspection.

properties.claim: Showthe scans one internal quantity through the_toks and prints then releases the resulting token list.
preconditions: Showthe dispatch and an internal quantity are current.
stimulus: Phase 2 white-box unit `showthe_uses_the_toks_for_each_internal_value_family_and_releases_output` covers scalar, glue, font, and token values.
expected_observations: Printed tokens equal the canonical the_toks result for the selected value.
postconditions: Temporary output tokens are freed and source state follows the scanned quantity.
equivalence_cases: Integer/dimension/glue/muglue/token/font values from named and register sources.
recovery_cases: Invalid internal quantities follow the_toks scanner recovery before printing.

properties.claim: Every show diagnostic ends diagnostics, reports OK, adjusts terminal/transcript routing, and supplies interaction-dependent non-error help.
preconditions: One show inspection branch has completed.
stimulus: Phase 2 white-box unit `show_completion_routes_transcript_and_adjusts_error_count_by_interaction` covers online/offline and interaction modes.
expected_observations: The transcript hint appears only when required and show does not count as an error below error-stop mode.
postconditions: Diagnostic selector and error count match canonical completion state.
equivalence_cases: Tracing online positive/nonpositive and error-stop versus lower interaction.
recovery_cases: Interactive continuation returns through the ordinary error routine without duplicating inspection.

properties.claim: After end or dump reaches final cleanup, TeX retires every remaining input level, balances open-file parentheses, reports but does not unsave open groups, reports and frees incomplete condition frames, emits history-dependent transcript guidance, and selects ordinary return versus INITEX format dump cleanup.
preconditions: its_all_over accepted end or dump and current command operand distinguishes the two paths.
stimulus: Phase 2 white-box unit `final_cleanup_retires_inputs_reports_open_state_and_selects_end_or_dump` covers nested source/token input, open groups/conditions, history/interaction states, and INITEX/production dump.
expected_observations: Input levels retire innermost-first; open groups are reported without restoration; each condition report uses its saved kind/line before the frame is freed; transcript guidance follows history and selector; dump releases marks/last glue then stores format only in INITEX.
postconditions: input_ptr and open_parens are zero, cond_ptr is null, group state is unchanged except for reporting, and end/dump returns at the canonical boundary.
equivalence_cases: End/dump with spotless/warning/error history, terminal/log selectors, zero/nested inputs, zero/open groups, zero/nested conditions, and INITEX/production profiles.
recovery_cases: Production dump prints the canonical INITEX-only diagnostic and returns without format storage; preexisting incomplete groups/conditions are reported and condition nodes are freed without invoking ordinary delimiter recovery.
